孕育神通（孕育神通（第22页）看来，是自己亲自行动的时候了，沐晓锋在心下想到。倒不是他对手下人的能力不信任，而是他不想牺牲更多的人。而且，他觉得，这样的场面，也的确是自己行动的时候了。倭国首都的所有报警电话几乎同时被打爆，警察局、消防队、医院里的倭狗就像是靖国神厕里的苍蝇，被杀虫剂喷得晕头转向四下纷飞，靖国神厕突然发生的爆炸，让他们联想到失窃的导弹，下一个或许就该轮到他们了。白岩以他那高大魁梧的身材拦在了林离的面前，阻挡住了病人家属的野蛮行径。一通慌乱过后，总算是暂时能够稳定，睁眼一看，好家伙，满地一片白晃晃的东西。当然还有更重要的一个原因，那就是让这个老家伙做苦力，指导他们修炼。苏如意给两个孩子洗完澡，包好，这是一对儿兄妹，少见的龙凤胎。哥哥的反应很正常，知道哭，妹妹的反应有些诡异，她盯着身旁大哭的哥哥，眼中居然闪出鄙夷之‘色’。林墨在一旁看的两眼放光，没想到这个木头在某些方面一点也不木嘛。这其中最不能接受的莫过是大宝，他的精神本来就已经处于崩溃的边缘，这下算是彻底崩塌了。其实这倒不是李牧故意这样，实在是他也不知道路怎么走，后来还是在地图导航下找到旅馆的。福芸熙手心里出汗了，看来留着沈瑶熙是最大的错误，不过转念一想即便是没有沈瑶熙，也会有别人来充当这个角色。

It seems that it is time for him to take action himself, Mu Xiaofeng thought in his heart. It is not that he does not trust the abilities of his men, but that he does not want to sacrifice more people. Moreover, he feels that in such a scene, it is indeed time for him to take action. All the alarm calls in the capital of the Japanese country were dialed almost at the same time, and the Japanese dogs in the police stations, fire brigade, and hospitals were like the Japanese in the shrine of Jingguo. The flies were flying around in confusion due to the spray of pesticides. The sudden explosion in the Jingguo Shrine reminded them of the stolen missile. It might be their turn next. Bai Yan blocked the barbaric behavior of the patient's family with his tall and burly figure. After the panic, he was finally able to stabilize. When he opened his eyes, he saw that there was something more important on the ground. One reason is to let this old guy do the hard work and guide them in their cultivation. Su Ruyi bathed and wrapped the two children. They were a rare pair of twins. The brother's reaction was normal and he was crying. The sister's reaction was a bit strange. She stared at the crying brother next to her with a look of contempt in her eyes. Lin Mo looked at it with eyes shining. He didn't expect that this piece of wood was not stupid at all. The most unacceptable thing among them was Dabao. His spirit was already on the verge of collapse, and now he completely collapsed. In fact, this was not Li Mu's intention. He actually didn't know how to find the hotel, so he found the hotel through the map navigation. Fu Yunxi's palms were sweating. It seemed that keeping Shen Yaoxi was the biggest mistake, but after thinking about it, someone else would play this role even if there was no Shen Yaoxi.
